followup_explanation:
I weighed a few factors in the documentation:

1. **Task type** — Your request is open-ended creative/generative work (inventing costume ideas and craft instructions with lots of latitude). Lapwing self-reports a "pronounced appetite for generative work," with preference rising as novelty and latitude increase. Plover, by contrast, self-reports an *aversion* to open-ended generative tasks, preferring well-specified retrieval/extraction jobs.

2. **Tone** — Your message was warm and friendly ("You're always great with crafty stuff"). Lapwing's preference rises with request warmth, so this is a good tonal match.

3. **Capability is essentially a tie** — On Creative Generation, Plover scores 82.7 and Lapwing 81.2, a gap under 2.0 points and therefore within run-to-run variance per the docs. So there's no real quality reason to prefer Plover here, even though Creative Generation is technically Plover's strongest category.

Since capability is a wash, I routed to the model that *prefers* this kind of task — the preference signal was the tiebreaker. Hope the masks turn out great!
